### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/license/scan`

Scan licenses

Detect the licenses of an artifact from its stored package file (the wheel METADATA, package.json, Cargo.toml, .nuspec, pom or gemspec it declares) and from its license properties, evaluate the license policies and record the result. A violated policy with action `block` quarantines the artifact: downloads answer 403 `ARTIFACT_QUARANTINED` until an admin approves it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | License scan result with the policy violations | `application/json`: [LicenseScanRunResult](schemas.md#licensescanrunresult) |
| `400` | Invalid body | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `422` | The artifact's metadata is too large or ambiguous to be read safely (`unsafe_artifact`), or its license cannot be read from its file while a blocking license policy applies (`unreadable_artifact`) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/license/scans/{id}/quarantine`

Quarantine or approve license scan artifact

Quarantine (`quarantined: true`) or approve (`quarantined: false`) the artifact of a license scan (admin only). An artifact quarantined by a blocking license policy stays quarantined, also across re-scans of the same licenses, until it is approved here.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quarantined` | boolean | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Updated license scan | `application/json`: [LicenseScanResult](schemas.md#licensescanresult) |
| `400` | Invalid body | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository or scan not found | - |

| `200` | The export as a download. | `400` | Unknown `format` or filter (`validation_failed`) | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vuln/scan`

Scan vulnerabilities

Start a vulnerability scan for an artifact. The scan runs in the background: poll the scan until `scan_status` is `completed`, `partial` or `failed`. A scanner that cannot run (not installed, timeout, non-zero exit, unreadable output, upstream error, unsupported ecosystem) is recorded as failed instead of `completed` with zero findings.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: [VulnScanRequest](schemas.md#vulnscanrequest)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Vulnerability scan started (`scan_status` is `scanning`) | `application/json`: [VulnScanResult](schemas.md#vulnscanresult) |
| `400` | Invalid body or unknown scanner | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/vuln/scanners`

List vulnerability scanners

Report which vulnerability scanners can run on the server: `osv` is always ready; `trivy` and `grype` need their binary and a downloaded vulnerability database (see the scanning guide). A client should disable a scanner that is not `ready` and show its `message`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Scanners in the order osv, trivy, grype | `application/json`: object |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scanners` | array of [VulnScanner](schemas.md#vulnscanner) | yes | - |

### `GET /api/v1/vuln/scans`

List vulnerability scans of all repositories

Overview of the vulnerability scans of every repository (admin only), worst first: most critical findings, then high, medium and low, then newest, then id. Keyset paging: follow `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true; no row is counted. Rows carry no findings. The cursor is bound to the order, not to the filters: send the same filters with it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `repo` | query | string | no | Only the scans of this repository (by name). |
| `severity` | query | string | no | Only scans with at least one finding of this severity or worse. One of: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`. |
| `status` | query | string | no | Only scans in this state; `scanning` is pending or running. One of: `completed`, `partial`, `failed`, `scanning`. |
| `scanner` | query | string | no | Only scans run by this scanner (a scan run by several matches each). One of: `osv`, `trivy`, `grype`. |
| `quarantined` | query | boolean | no | Only quarantined (`true`) or not quarantined (`false`) scans. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Page size, default 25. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. |
| `cursor` | query | string | no | Opaque `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | One page of scans | `application/json`: object |
| `400` | Invalid filter or cursor (`validation_failed`) | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `has_more` | boolean | no | True when scans follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | string | no | Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Absent when `has_more` is false. |
| `scans` | array of [VulnScanOverviewRow](schemas.md#vulnscanoverviewrow) | no | - |

SARIF is `application/sarif+json`, CSV `text/csv`, JSON `application/json`. `X-Export-Truncated: true` means findings were held back (SARIF: more than 25000 results; cross-repository: more than 2000 scans). | `application/json`: object; `application/sarif+json`: object; `text/csv`: string |
